note: Minified release bundle sizes in bytes (all remeasured 2026-10-10 after the second simplification pass: hub-owned registration, one shared host binding, plain modules). Budgets allow up to 5% growth rounded up to whole KiB. Raise one only with the reason recorded in this note. Rank remeasured at 117,950 bytes for retained vote comparison sums, shifted cold weights, bounded task yielding, shared cancellable preparation and complete-score rendering; its budget is 121 KiB (5% rounded up). DirtyTasks now combines those organization/tag features with additive encoding, isolated section saves and migration; output review is removed. Its initial budget is 60 KiB. DirtyTasks 1.0.2 adds independent action/rule trigger selectors and retains the existing 60 KiB budget. DirtyTasks 1.0.3 adds conditional recovery status and warning feedback within the existing 60 KiB budget. DirtyPlugins 1.0.8 was remeasured at 46,719 bytes (about 1.75 KB more than 1.0.7) for the header settings button and its show/hide setting; its budget is 48 KiB (5% rounded up). DirtyStats 1.0.9 moves ECharts and the world map into assets/dirtyStatsCharts.js, which loads only when a Stats page opens: the bundle every Stash page loads drops from 1,151,287 to 160,315 bytes (budget 165 KiB), and the chart file is recorded as a chunk at 1,000,127 bytes (budget 1026 KiB). DirtyMultiscreen 1.0.17 was remeasured at 36,978 bytes for seven scene orders (weighted, fewer-repeats and mixed shuffles) and performer/studio spreading; its budget is 38 KiB (5% rounded up).
